site.description: Shockbliss is a bold, artful online store where the products may change, but the style stays. Each product is designed and handmade.

shockbliss-fanny-pack.description:
This stylish, practical bag has it all:

  • Water-resistant material
  • Pockets and compartments to keep your belongings organized
  • Eye-catching patterns
  • Detachable strap
  • Lightweight
  • Handmade

These bags are inspired by repurposed fabrics and abstract photographs taken of them.
